at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0002.title: Normalize money via to_money and round_money
at-0002.content: Never store raw unit_price values; pass them through to_money() and round_money() from ledgerly/money.py before constructing LineItem, and compare against ZERO for negativity.

at-0004.content: Mutating invoice operations must first check invoice.status != "draft" and raise BillingError("invalid_state", ...), matching issue_invoice in ledgerly/invoice.py.

at-0007.title: Money operations accept keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events(<event>)` for a matching key and return the original result without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` entry.

at-0009.content: Every payment state transition must emit an `audit.record` event (e.g. `payment_authorized`, `payment_captured`) carrying payment_id and amount; read prior events with `audit.events(name)`.
